note: Closed variety of request call sites read by scripts/user_path_failures.py (flow_requests, AR-1, FR-13). A call row says how one request is spelled in code: `start` finds the call on a line (it never carries the comment guard, `comment` does, so one line may hold several calls), the group `url` is the address and the group `method` (or `method_in_window` in the next `window_lines` lines, stopping before the next call) the verb. An interpolation becomes a placeholder named after the template variable (`name_of`, else `unnamed_as`); a concatenated operand the same way (`concat_tail`); the query string is cut. A client of a project that this table does not hold is the strategist's to add (AR-2); a new shape is a row here, never a list in code. A row that does not compile is named as not measured, the others still run.
